ads.blockNote: These sellers paid to show these products. They match your search and meet our trust requirements. Paying does not change a seller's verification badge or the normal search order.
ads.endOfSponsored: End of sponsored products. Search results follow.
ads.similarNote: Paid placements matched to this product. Separate from our normal similar products.
ads.rankingDescription: The main factors that decide the order of search results and how sponsored products are chosen, in plain language.
ads.rankingIntro: You should know why you see what you see. This page explains how we order search results, what a Sponsored label means, and what is never for sale.
ads.organicP1: Products are ordered by how well they match what you typed (the words and the meaning), adjusted by the seller's trust score. Trust comes from verification, reliability in replying, buyer feedback and dispute record, and can move a product's score by up to about {trustPct}%.
ads.organicP2: Sellers in the city you mention get a small boost of about {locationPct}%.
ads.organicP3: A seller's plan, payments and ads do not affect this order.
ads.sponsoredP1: A product marked Sponsored is an advertisement. The seller paid a fixed price when a buyer clicks it. It is always labelled, in a separate block, and never mixed into the normal order.
ads.sponsoredWho: Who can advertise: sellers verified at tier {minTier} or higher, with a trust score of at least {trustFloor}. The product must be published, approved by our moderation, have an approved photo and a price, and be in a permitted category.
ads.sponsoredHow: How a sponsored product is chosen: by how relevant it is to your search multiplied by the seller's trust, the same trust weighting used for normal results. A product that is not relevant to your search is never shown, whatever the seller pays.
ads.sponsoredPrice: Price: a public fixed price per click by category. There is no bidding, so paying more does not rank a seller higher.
ads.sponsoredCaps: Limits: at most {maxSlots} sponsored products on a results page, no more than 1 for every {perOrganic} results, never more than {sharePct}% of the products on a page, none when fewer than {minOrganic} results match, and only one per seller on a page. A product already in the normal results is not repeated as an ad.
ads.sponsoredRefund: Sellers are not charged for invalid clicks such as bots, repeat clicks or clicks from their own team.
ads.never2: Priority for the enquiries (leads) sellers receive.
ads.contactP: If an ad looks wrong or misleading, tell us through our grievance form and we will review it.
ads.comingSoonText: Sponsored products are not live yet. When they start, they will follow the rules on this page.
